Name: Terraria Emoji Pack
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[size=5]🐸 [/size][b][size=5]About This Mod[/size][/b]
This is a [b]content pack[/b] for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29215]Custom Emotes Menu[/url].
It adds a collection of custom emojis that you can use in-game via the emoji menu!

[b]📌 Note:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29215]Custom Emotes Menu[/url] does [b]not replace[/b] the vanilla emote menu — it creates an entirely [b]new custom emoji system[/b].
To open the new emoji menu, just press the [b][color=#00ff00]Q[/color][/b] key (by default).
I recommend checking out the main mod page to better understand how it works!

[line]

[size=5]📦 [b]Requirements[/b][/size]
To use this mod, you [b]must first install[/b]:

🔹 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29215][b]Custom Emotes Menu[/b][/url]
That mod provides the system for displaying new emojis in-game.
This pack simply adds new emoji images on top of that.

[line]

[size=5]📁 [b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29215]Custom Emotes Menu[/url].

[*]Download this content pack.

[*]Extract it into your mods folder.
[/list]

✅ That’s it! Your new emojis will appear in the menu automatically.
